title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Margo Howard, daughter of advice columnist Ann Landers, passed away last month at age 86 in Cambridge.
Margo wrote Dear Prudence for Slate and Dear Margo for The Boston Globe, offering practical, empathetic advice.
Meredith Goldstein reflects on Margo's influence, valuing her advice to balance grief with finding joy after loss.

title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Payton Tolle struck out 14 batters in the Red Sox's 13-1 win against the Athletics at Fenway Park.
Boston Red Sox extended their winning streak to nine games, with a record now standing at 64-51.
Boston's offense tallied 15 hits, including a five-run second inning, boosting them to a comfortable victory.

title: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez continue sharpening each other’s games at Patriots training camp
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez are engaging in competitive, trash-talking matchups at the Patriots training camp.
Gonzalez is honing his skills for a challenging 2026 schedule, prepping against top receivers like Brown.
Robert Kraft hinted at offering Gonzalez a new lucrative deal amid his standout camp performances.

title: New Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman to begin rehab assignment this weekend
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Adley Rutschman begins rehab assignment with Triple-A Worcester Red Sox Saturday.
Rutschman was acquired from Orioles on Monday for three prospects and Carlos Narvaez.
Rutschman recovering from left wrist inflammation, injured list since July 20.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' is streaming on Paramount+, featuring Aang facing a new threat alongside Dave Bautista.
'You, Me & Tuscany' starring Halle Bailey and Regé-Jean Page is available on Peacock with its Italian countryside setting.
'Sterling Point' Season 1 on Prime Video follows Annie discovering a family inheritance and unexpected family in Canada.

title: Could Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox in a bullpen role?
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Garrett Crochet may return to the Boston Red Sox bullpen in 2026 after prolonged injury rehab.
Interim manager Chad Tracy expressed doubt about Crochet returning as a starter due to health concerns.
Crochet, previously successful as a reliever, is open to pitching from the bullpen if needed.

title: Lost a python? Boston Animal Care and Control might have it.
author: Heather Alterisio
bullets: A ball python was found near Ellington Street in Dorchester and is temporarily named 'Tippy'.
Tippy was left in a cage near community garden beds and taken to a care facility by Animal Control.
Officials urge information on the python's owner via 617-635-1800 or [email protected].

title: Tommy DeVito bests Drake Maye, and other takeaways from Patriots’ training camp scrimmage
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Tommy DeVito led Team Blue to a 22-15 victory over Drake Maye's Team White in the Patriots' scrimmage.
DeMario Douglas stood out for Team Blue with six catches and two touchdowns, including a 50-yard scoring play.
Mike Vrabel provided injury updates, noting Will Campbell's expected return and Carlton Davis's continued absence.

title: A closer look at Harwich, voted the best town on Cape Cod by Boston.com readers
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Harwich was voted the best town on Cape Cod by over 850 Boston.com readers.
Harwich features nearly 11 miles of shoreline along Nantucket Sound and Pleasant Bay.
The town offers diverse attractions including beaches, conservation areas, and local eateries.

title: DA’s office says prosecutor’s ‘hot mic’ moment in Lindsay Clancy trial was misheard
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Plymouth DA's Office clarifies a remark during the Lindsay Clancy trial, stating 'shut it off' referred to autopsy photos.
Defense attorney Kevin Reddington accused prosecutors of saying 'shut her up' while Clancy was sobbing in court.
Judge William Sullivan issued warnings against inappropriate or disruptive comments during courtroom proceedings.
